# Financial Transaction

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:FinancialTransaction`](gmeow-FinancialTransaction.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/FinancialTransaction>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/finance`](../../slices/finance.md)

A money-movement event — a payment, transfer, deposit, withdrawal, fee, interest, or refund. Reuses the [`Event`](gmeow-Event.md)/Participation substrate: payer, payee, and intermediary are [`ParticipantRole`](gmeow-ParticipantRole.md) values on [`Participation`](gmeow-Participation.md) relators, never subproperties. The kind of transaction is a [`TransactionType`](gmeow-TransactionType.md) value; the status is a [`TransactionStatus`](gmeow-TransactionStatus.md) value.

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Event`](gmeow-Event.md)
